features: Apartment video door station with 15-button braille keypad and 3.97-inch 800x480 screen
2MP low-illumination starlight image sensor with auto illumination and IR illuminator
Built-in IC card reader (13.56 MHz), card capacity 15,000, person capacity 15,000, event capacity 100,000
Uniview deep-learning recognition (rate >99%, false rate <1%, recognition speed up to 0.2 s)
WDR; controls two doors; Wiegand, RS485, dual door-lock interface, IO in/out
Built-in heating module for very low temperature operation; call and intercom with indoor stations and app

frigate.notes: Apartment door station. Supports RTSP (TCP/IP, HTTP, RTP, RTSP, NTP); no ONVIF advertised (UNV private protocol). Exact RTSP stream path not published.

home_assistant.notes: RTSP stream (generic camera). UNV private protocol plus RTSP.

blue_iris.notes: Uniview RTSP; exact path not published.
